Package org.apache.poi.sl.usermodel

Interface HighlightColorSupport

All Known Implementing Classes:
XSLFTextRun
public interface HighlightColorSupport
An interface to provide support for get/set of highlight color in XLSFTextRuns instances. Spec Ref: 21.1.2.3.4 (ECMA-376-1 5th ed. Ecma Office Open XML Part 1 - Fundamentals And Markup Language Reference.pdf)
Since:
5.2.4

  • Method Details

    • getHighlightColor

      PaintStyle getHighlightColor()
      Returns the font highlight (background) color for this text run. This returns a PaintStyle.SolidPaint, or null if no highlight is set.
      Returns:
      The font highlight (background) colour associated with the run, null if no highlight.
      Since:
      5.2.4
